angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 850,145 km at 142.82 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.0016 +/- 0.0156 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 142.82 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.222 +/- 0.036 solar radii from Lillo-Box et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4492 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract): 850,145 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.067 +/- 0.055 solar masses from Lillo-Box et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4492 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5711 +/- 83 K from Lillo-Box et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4492 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lillo-Box et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4492 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-4492.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.292, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4492 (pscomppars): spectral type G2 V, from Lillo-Box et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4492 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.219 dex, from Lillo-Box et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4492 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.15546, from Lillo-Box et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1857593254122163712, flags_flame 00: age_flame 13.199232 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 11.786222 to 13.5)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4492 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3 km/s, from Lillo-Box et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026arXiv260719756L/abstract)
